observations: White chest freezer with a stainless steel top lid and handle.
A red manufacturer's logo is visible on the top left of the lid in photo 0.
A blue and white sticker on the front door claims a 3-year warranty and 120 hours cooling retention.
The unit is sitting on a concrete floor against a plain wall.
The brand name 'SUNRISE' is visible on the top left of the lid in photo 0.
The rear control panel is visible but the brand name is not clearly legible in the photo.

claims.evidence: The capacity is not clearly legible on the sticker or the unit itself in the photo.
The voltage rating is not visible on the unit in the photo.
The sticker in photo 0 explicitly states this.

risks.risk: The freezer may not cool or may have a faulty compressor.
risks.proof: A video showing the interior of the freezer with a thermometer or a thermometer probe inside.

risks.risk: The capacity may be significantly smaller than 250 liters.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the technical specification plate on the back or side of the unit.

risks.risk: The unit may be a different brand or model than the one shown.
risks.proof: A photo of the manufacturer's specification plate.
risks.if_unproven: as a generic or unknown brand model

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the technical specification plate (usually on the back or side) to confirm the capacity and voltage.
Video of the freezer running with the door open to see the interior and temperature.
response.reason: The brand and model are clearly identified from the manufacturer's logo on the lid. The item can be priced at its worst-case functional state (non-working) until proof of capacity and operation is provided.
